note: 身份：末地竞速的主持者与纪录保持者。关系：从邀玩家挑战到认可对手。语言：随意、自信。性格：爱较劲，也乐于鼓励。固定词：竞速、纪录；不强加网络梗。

lines.context: Guber 的末地往返竞速任务与分阶段奖励对话
lines.raw: The End is a large island... my favorite hobby is racing across it!
lines.text: The End is a large island... my favorite hobby is racing across it!
lines.zh: 末地这么大……我最喜欢的事，就是在岛上来一场赛跑!

lines.context: Guber 的末地往返竞速任务与分阶段奖励对话
lines.raw: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!
lines.text: My best time is pretty fast, you probably will never beat me. But you can try!
lines.zh: 我的最好成绩可快了，你大概永远都超不过。不过，试试也无妨!

lines.context: Guber 的末地往返竞速任务与分阶段奖励对话
lines.raw: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the §eopposite side of the island §rand come all the way back.
lines.text: To complete the race, you'll need to reach the opposite side of the island and come all the way back.
lines.zh: 想跑完全程，你得先到岛的另一头，再一路跑回来。

lines.raw: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 3 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!
lines.text: Start the race by walking over the pressure plate. If you finish in under 3 minutes, I'll reward you for it! Good luck!

lines.raw: Not bad, %s!

lines.raw: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that I do.
lines.text: But you can get a much quicker time if you use the items that I do.
